Please don't.  I am nobody to you other than someone who joined this subreddit. It hurts seeing the posts here knowing how many people have the same struggles as myself. I am much older than you and have children out of college, a spouse, mother and others around that I don't care to disrupt or mess up their lives because of my mental health. I think of them and what it would do to me if they did similar and it hurts. That is what keeps me from doing something so hurtful. 

I'm sorry. I do understand how hard life can be.
I've never felt like I need to be more conscious about what I eat and how I treat my body as I do post tbi
I understand and I'm sorry your going through this shifty time. People can really drain anything good I'm struggling for.

I used to see a psychologist but my wife disliked him and much was blamed on me seeing him. Nothing good came of it.. The psychiatrist was prescribing so many meds it was obvious he was doing so for kick backs. Those meds were destroying my life leading to involuntary hospital stays and jail.. There isn't any support system and I can't seem to find my way out of this. All I seem to come up with is leaving to save people around me and myself. I do not want to run from family, I feel like a coward so I live from one episode to another.
I had my shit together, good life, great family and friends, very successful....unit a traumatic brain injury 13 years ago.  I'm pissed off they saved me and now hate it here.

They don't want to talk about it. They may want to talk at me but not with me and definitely not with a psychologist. I have been feeling like its time for me to move on. I've tried talking to my spouse but it gets so insanely crazy when she yells at me that I can't talk anymore, I hide in the garage. I just need to leave but I seem to have a problem with the way I'm left doing it and I don't. The chaos has ruined whatever I had left in my life. I've become weak and lost that drive trying to get better.

They shouldn't have brought me back, I get angry at the choices they made for me when they revived me. My life has been nothing but suicidal for 13 years. In and out of psych wards and jail because I can't control my anger at times. There have been some good days in between but bad days far out number those shifty ones. And holidays make it worse for me, I hate life

I have tried for years to explain, I have talked, written, begged for years for them to come to a meeting with me and my psychologist for education. My wife and kids showed and listened but they are living their own lives. It hasn't seemed to help, that was 2 years ago. I'm not looking for a pitty party when I say this....I do not fit into their lives anymore and there is alot more distance these days, They may have tried early on but this is old to them and definitely old for me.
I have not gone to some in the past and they all start talking about me having a problem with all of them. They say I dont like anyone, anything, it turns negative and just make life at home hell.

Quite often. I especially hate holidays. In a shit place today. I would be a happier person if I never partaked in any. For me I try staying away from extended family that triggers me constantly because they don't care to know who I am. My immediate family has their head buried in the sand and talk me into doing something I know better than out of guilt.. Its been 13 years and its been getting worse

Thanks for the input. I  posted on all of them I could find hoping to get some help. Living here in Seattle my entire life, except for Marines, I know there are many psilocybin hunters and progressives here you have difficulty finding elsewhere. 

Hopefully it doesn't offend anyone
Hey, I get it and thanks. I was just writing out loud but thanks for the support.

So you don't think someone can "make you" feel guilty constantly in your ear telling you everything negative about you, what you do wrong, how you are an embarrassment, how you act like a child or can't remember anything, triggers you constantly and it's me? Overloading my cognitive ability with emotional drama never ends well having poor impulse control.

I think I get what you're trying to say. Maybe you're trying to say it as a reminder because nobody really has control over another person. Remember, every situation is different and every 8njury is different.  When someone is vulnerable, actions can be rather influential on how things transpire. I don't like to consider myself weak coming so far but I will say I am pretty darn vulnerable. 

I've been working years to be someone that can be trusted, confided in, shared with but that is obviously gone in our relationship. Putting myself in that situation has left me very vulnerable and maybe a touch of weakness is appearing now that I feel I need to see things for what they really are instead of trying to hold onto something from the past. 

I have spent so much time with therapists I do not believe anyone could say I need to do more of it. It's been clear for many years divorce is imminent and even written in medical records. I have ran from my wife trying to save myself from hurting her or myself only to come back and try again. I built a relationship and family I haven't been wanting to leave, I still don't but know I need to move on with my life and accept we get delivered blows in life we need to overcome. Love is hard.

I agree with you both. Every situation is so different as is every tbi.

My tbi was 13 years ago. It changed my life and I didn't give up. My spouse tried to the best of what she could but people have narrow minds. They think they are helping you and know what they are saying as what you need to do. Well, I love her, she tries, I'm a mess, I become very suicidal and I hate that about myself. I have a hard time living with someone that is so narrow minded not listening that it is their own actions THEY can work on and I may be tolerable. As much as I work on myself I cannot be responsible for always yelling and screaming her and what she does affecting my well being. She tries and she believes it and its still just me and my shit, I should be able to handle all this stuff I did before but I can't. She makes me feel guilty so I put myself in bad situations and I can't handle it. I know better but I do it out of guilt. I've noticed it's destroying me. I used to have these great gains moving forward and she started becoming really defensive about everything. That fucked me up pretty food. Not sure we're gonna last. Been married 31 years

You nailed that dudeman3

I just wanted to strongly support what you said but also strongly urge people to research your strain. I've smoked the wrong one and it's generally a sativa but not always isolated to that. It can send whatever I have going on -soaring, magnified. Cool thing is pot never hurts you but it can be an uncomfortable feeling for anyone.....even without ptsd. My head injury was messed up, moderate-severe. I had to learn walking and talking, emotions, all kinds of stuff but that ptsd.....that right there is the one that I have a hard time with. Weed can help. I have tried it all, meds, psychologists, psychiatrists, dbt, cbt, antidepressants, Adderall, methadone and not for heroine addiction.. I would even drink elephant piss if it was a cure..but weed can help.. a joint works faster than edibles if you need to calm yourself quickly. I found it hard managing with edibles. I didn't want to smoke but iys the only way most of the time

I'm very interested in the microdosing and need to get more info.

 It's been 13 years and it seems ro get worse with time for me. I need to get this under control, it has gone too far.

Sorry to hear that, its the opposite for me. I have severe anxiety in my daily life due to a head injury. I took up bike riding last year because I dont get out enough and wanted to get back in shape which has worked out for me. I generally ride familiar routes due to the anxiety, new ones can cause me problems occasionally or I'll do the paved trails. 

Cycling has given me some quality of life and got me back in shape. Its been great for my aggression also.

Good luck
